arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mohawk Industries argues that a corporation is a single legal entity.
The plaintiffs argue that the company and recruiters formed a criminal group.
Justice Breyer questioned the logic of excluding corporations from enterprise definitions.
Justice Scalia questioned whether the issue was properly before the Court.
